question: Which of the four Vedas is traditionally paired with the Upaveda known as Gandharvaveda?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Samaveda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Samaveda** is one of the four Vedas and is primarily associated with music and chants.
 
• It is traditionally paired with the **Upaveda known as Gandharvaveda**, which deals with music, dance, and other performing arts.
 
• Gandharvaveda is considered the **Upaveda (subsidiary Veda)** of Samaveda because of its focus on the melodic and rhythmic aspects of Vedic hymns.
 
• Samaveda consists of hymns that are to be sung during sacrificial rituals, emphasizing the importance of sound and melody in religious ceremonies.
 
• The connection between Samaveda and Gandharvaveda highlights the role of music and performance in ancient Indian spiritual practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rigveda:**

 
 
• The Rigveda is the oldest of the four Vedas and is a collection of hymns dedicated to various deities.
 
• It focuses on cosmology, philosophy, and rituals and forms the foundation of Vedic literature.
 
• It is not traditionally associated with any specific Upaveda.
 
 
 
• **Yajurveda:**
 
 
• The Yajurveda deals with the procedural aspects of rituals and sacrifices.
 
• It provides instructions for performing yajnas (sacrificial ceremonies).
 
• The Upaveda associated with Yajurveda is **Dhanurveda**, which deals with warfare, archery, and military science.
 
 
 
• **Atharvaveda:**
 
 
• The Atharvaveda contains hymns, charms, and spells for everyday life and is considered more practical in nature compared to the other Vedas.
 
• The Upaveda linked with Atharvaveda is **Ayurveda**, which focuses on medicine and health.
